newsitem.title: USA: Jones Education proposed IPO price range.
newsitem.headline: Jones Education proposed IPO price range.

text.p: Jones Education Networks Inc set a price range of $14 to $16 a share for its proposed initial public offering, according to a regulatory filing.
In the IPO, Jones will sell 5.8 million shares and certain shareholders will sell 1.1 million.
The company proposes to trade under the symbol "JECO" on the Nasdaq. Jones offers educational programming through its two television networks, ME/U Knowledge TV and Jones Computer Network.
Montgomery Securities, the lead underwriter of the offering, says the deal does not yet have a firm schedule date.
